We never meant to start Pet Angel Adoption. We didn't wake up one day and say "Let's start a cat rescue!" It started with two litter of kittens in Nancy and Jim Engel's backyard in little Frankenmuth, Michigan. When that two litter of kittens became cages of cats in the Engel Family's garage, Nancy and Jim realized what they had gotten into. They couldn't just stop saving kitties lives and finding them forever homes, so they rented out a building on List Street in Frankenmuth, moved the cats to the new location, and Pet Angel was born. 

Today, Pet Angel Adoption and Rescue is a volunteer-based, non-profit, no-kill cat shelter in that same building on List Street. We specialize in more than just the saving and rehoming of homeless, helpless and injured kitties, but we also offer awesome programs to the public in the Frankenmuth.
